title: Krak3n_

replies.author: Arachadonic
replies.body:
Hey notal, 
People using autism as an intended insult is something I take very seriously and as I have autism it does sadden me when I see players, usually children, using autism as an intended insult as if it is a bad thing to have autism. 
That said, while I found this very rude and disrespectful there really is not enough here for me to really punish the player. I will however keep an eye out for him/her and will make sure they don't commit another similar act. 

Thanks for reporting anyway and drawing our attention to the player!
